evidence.matches_on: keywords (EXACT bare key membership in item.keywords), not a name substring. pytest builds needlessly-bare keyword keys from: the item's own full name (key 'test_param[live]', key 'test_lively' — neither equals 'live'), the enclosing module/class names, mark names, and EACH PARAMETRISATION ID AS A BARE KEY. Measured with pytest 9.1.1: test_lively/test_livewire/test_olive/test_live -> NOT matched; test_param[live] (parametrize id 'live') -> MATCHED; @pytest.mark.live -> MATCHED (intended). So the live channel is a bare parametrisation id, a module/class literally named 'live', or the mark.
